paragraphs.text: Ivora , also known as the Insatiable Heir , is a vampire warrior from an unknown plane.

Ivora is a character who debuted in Foundations Jumpstart as part of the Red Bloody deck . She is a green-skinned vampire with pointy ears and long purple hair somewhat similar to some goblins . She wears a purple dress and wields a red sword, which appears to be surrounded by blood mist. She creates blood tokens when entering attacking, while also gaining power and toughness from cards being discarded.
